segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: My next question, does the proposed budget address those constraints through better information sharing,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: additional operating resources, or new surveillance capabilities?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: We want a gradual increase in operations as well.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: As far as your surveillance capabilities, Mr. Speaker?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: How are the information expenditure requirements coordinated with the Philippine Coast Guard and other relevant agencies?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, you mean the coordination between the Philippine Coast Guard and other relevant agencies required expenditure and sharing of information.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: and civilian maritime personnel expect in case of emergency?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Communication assistance and coordination during incidents at sea?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, ano pong inaasaan ng ating mga fishermen in case na, as we know,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: lagi natin napapanood, laging may aksidente niyan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: The Coast Guard is increasing its fleet. It is also coordinating with the Philippines with regard to increasing the fleet capacity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, does the fisherman, inaalalayan ba sila ng ating mga Coast Guard pag sila'y nasa laot?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Are they being given instruction or advice where to go, where to do their fishing?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Pag nangingisda sila, mayroon ba tayong sinusunod na or area kung saan sila pwede maghanap buhay?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: The Coast Guard and the BFAR, there is also assistance for fuel.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Then, my next question, balikatan exercises.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Defense benefits, costs, and management of regional tension.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: The Philippines has broadened its joint military activities with defense partners,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: including the United States, Japan, France.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Balikatan 2026 included activities in Itbayat, Batanes, near Taiwan, and drew criticism from China.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Question: What specific defense objectives do these exercises seek to achieve?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: The objective really is terrain awareness.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: The idea of the department is a whole 360 terrain awareness.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: So, all of the exercises, air exercises, land exercises, are in pursuit of that objective of terrain awareness.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: So, it's basically acclimatizing our troops towards the terrain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Another objective also is to introduce our troops to new types of defense.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, in short, we do this exercise through awareness.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: At the same time, siguro para matrain din ang ating mga sandatang lakas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: My question, do China think this balikatan exercise as an aggressive toward them?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Given the scale of the operations, there won't be any reason for it to be treated as aggression.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: At least that is the stance of the department.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Then again, all of these joint activities are somewhat construed as provocative given its objective.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Madam Sponsor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: What measurable improvements in the armed forces' capabilities have resulted from previous exercises?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Did we gain anything from the Balikatan exercises as far as our armed forces is concerned?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Actually, one of the successes of the Balikatan exercises is that the experience of those exercises enabled the Philippines to lead a 40-fighter strike in Australia.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: So, it just shows the increase in the capabilities of our troops because of these Balikatan exercises.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Last question for this particular department.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Balikatan exercises, and I move to the other topic.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: What measures are in place to prevent miscalculation and manage regional tensions while preserving the Philippines' independent defense decision?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, it's strict adherence to UNCLOS and international law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And I'll move to my next topic, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: This regards the drone expansion, artificial intelligence, and secure systems.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: August 25, 2026, Budget Hearing Secretary Teodoro discussed expanding the military's unmanned capabilities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: He emphasized that effective use requires operational integration, secure communication, and supporting networks,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: not simply the acquisition of more drones.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: How does proposed 2027 budget ensure that drone acquisitions are accompanied by the systems and trained personnel needed to use them effectively?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: So, these integration systems are being introduced in this particular budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: This would be under C4ISTAR, so Command, Control, Communication, Computers, Intelligence, Surveillance, Target Acquisition, and Reconnaissance,

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: which is one of the core pillars of the comprehensive archipelagic defense concept.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Do you know how, Mr. Speaker, do you know how, and District Sponsor, do you know how much the budget for these drones?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: For the fiscal year 2027 proposed budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, it's the funding of the governance systems first before,

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: the governance systems for the drones before we actually use the drones.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: So, we need to fund the governance systems first.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Does the department use artificial intelligence models to process imagery,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: identify unusual activity, or prioritize information for human analysts?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Would additional funding produce greater benefits if directed toward analytical personnel, communications, and maintenance rather than additional equipment alone?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Now, I move to another topic.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Expanded defense partnerships and their budgetary requirements.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: The Philippines and France signed a visiting forces agreement in March 2026.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: the target for bilateral and multilateral engagement also rises from 159 in 2026 to 242 in 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: What capability gains justify the proposed increase in bilateral and multilateral engagement?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker. There are classified capability changes that the department is already observing with regard to our capabilities and defense posture. That would justify the increase of the targets of our bilateral and multilateral partnerships with other government partners.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Thank you. Next, I have only three last questions, three questions. What arrangements determine which costs are borne by the Philippines and which are borne by partner countries?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: The general rule is, if it's an expense incurred of our troops, of our machinery, then that's our counterpart cost.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Whereas, those that involve the troops and the machinery of counterparts, then the counterparts bear that cost.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, in short, what's the proposition? Kanya-kanya sila?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Most likely, it's a 50-50 proposition. Fair enough. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Next, how does the department assess?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Whether participation improves operational proficiency or interoperability?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes, every exercise, Mr. Speaker, is scored. There is an assessment with regards to indicators.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: For my last question, which recently completed defense initiative has produced the clearest measurable improvement relative to its cost and what made it successful?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, the department says it's Exercise Pitch Black, which was conducted in Australia.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Okay. Again, Mr. Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor, I support the budget of Department of National Defense and to the ND family, thank you for your service. Thank you very much, Mr. Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Arnan C. Panaligan
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, I move to recognize the Honorable Sarah Jane Elago of Partylist Gabriela Women's Party for her interpellation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Una tungkol sa tatag ng infrastruktura para sa kapayapaan at siguridad projects o mga tikas projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mula taong 2019 hanggang 2025, may total budget ang tikas program, ang convergence program ng DND at DPWH na P38.03 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mula 2019 hanggang end of 2025, ilan na nga ba talaga ang total approved tikas projects?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ilan dito ang complete, ongoing, delayed, unusable, suspended, at magsisimula pa lang?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang mga katanungan po na ito ay naitanong na rin natin noong budget briefing, ngunit hindi po tayo nakakuha noong detalyado na status report na kada proyekto.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At medyo nalito pa po tayo dahil magkakaiba po yung bilang ng proyekto na naibigay po sa representasyon na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Una, noong October 8, 2025, sang-ayon po kay DND Secretary Chodoro sa isang news report, sinabi na may 944 approved projects mula 2019 at 648 projects dito ang kumpleto na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngunit sa pareho, ayon naman kay AFP Chief of Staff Brawner, from 2019 to 2025, ang TIKAS po ay may 927 approved infrastructure projects, samantalang 663 ang completed at meron pang 139 na ongoing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nakuha natin na submission mula sa Department of National Defense. Mula 2021 hanggang 2026, ang Philippine Army may 472 TICAS projects worth 14.496 billion. At para naman sa Philippine Air Force, mula taong 2019 hanggang 2025, meron pong 159 projects worth 4.806 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yung bilang po na nakuha natin mula sa 2021 hanggang 2026 sa Philippine Army at mula sa 2019 hanggang 2025 ay hindi po nagtutugma dun sa 900 plus approved projects na unang nabalita mula noong nakaraang taon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maari po ba itong maipaliwanag ng ating distinguished sponsor? At kung maaari po makapagbigay kayo ng ano po ba talaga yung datos?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker. For the TIKAS program, if I may enumerate: for the Philippine Army from 2021 to 2026, the number of projects is 413. That is the total number of projects, 413. For the Philippine Air Force from 2019 to 2025, it is 159 projects. For the Philippine Navy from 2019 to 2025, it is 117 projects. And then the GHQ proper from 2020 to 2026 is 233 projects. So that totals to 922 total projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: For those that have been completed, for the Philippine Army, it's 273 completed projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: For the Philippine Air Force, it's 133 completed projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: So that's a total of 509 projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, saan po nanggagaling yung nasa 400 plus na unaccounted dun po sa naiulat ninyo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kasi ang sabi po noong October 2025, 944 po yung total na bilang ng approved projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At mangingila lang po ako ng detalya nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pwede po ba natin kunin ang commitment ng ating distinguished sponsor, ang DND, pagdating po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kasi gusto po natin makita saan ba yung lakasyon, saan ba napunta yung pondo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: natapos na ba talaga ang mga infrastruktura,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: upang matiyak natin na ang pondo po ng ating bayan ay napupunta talaga sa kung saan ito layon na magasta.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon po, yung nabanggit nyo ng mga completed na mga projects,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: lahat ba ito may turnover documents na?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At lahat ba ito ay natayo sa mga lupa na meron ng titulo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, tumatakbo ang aking oras. May I pause habang naghihintay sa ating distinguished sponsor?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, well, first, just to address the number.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Ito po kasing number 922, ito po yung completed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: But meron kasi tayo ng mga projects na designed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Depende kasi yun dun sa design.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: So minsan nagkakaproblema po tayo dun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Kaya po, hindi po siya nako-complete.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Kasi besides na iba yung disenyo, minsan po yung lupa may dispute.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: So yung binention ko po na 509 na completed projects,

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: completed po siya kasi yun po talaga yung na-turnover na proper documentation and all that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: yung rest po, yung differential na yung 122 at saka ng 509,

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: may facing po kasi talaga siya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Gusto rin pong sabihin ng departamento na

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: ang implementing agency po ng TCAS ay ang DPWH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: So, kung may mga ganito pong mga katanungan in terms of

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: ano yung rason for the delays,

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: DPWH po ang mapapagtanungan natin ng mga konserwasyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mister Speaker, hindi po ba kasaba ang DND sa nag-issue ng Joint Memorandum Circular No. 44,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maari po ba itong balikan ng ating Distinguished Sponsor at ng ating departamento?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Anong sinasabi dyan na obligation po ng DND pagdating sa monitoring at evaluation

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ng mga proyekto sa ilalim ng TCAS program?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker. As of now, with regards to those that have been the ongoing projects from the time before 2025, continuing pa po yung validation of these projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Nag-conduct po ng validation and assessment din ang Department of National Defense.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: In terms of kamusta yung mga structure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: But yung implementing agency po talaga kasi ay DPWH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: So, pero on the part of the DND, we are assured na kung meron mang delays po doon sa implementation ng itong mga TICAS projects, ay nag-a-assess din po on-site ang DND.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Meron na po bang risulta ang inyong mga initial assessment?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Halimbawa, Mr. Speaker, nabanggit din po noong budget briefing na meron po for 2026, 27 non-implementable at may 51 na implementable pa na proyekto sa ilalim ng TICAS program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ano po ba ang ibig sabihin ng binanggit na non-implementable?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ibig sabihin po ba may mga limitations?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa paggamit ng budget? May mga, meron ba ang factor ng impossibility

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: dahil sa mga problema halimbawa sa lupa na katulad ng nabanggit

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ng ating distinguished sponsor? May update po ba kayo kung nagbago na

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ang mga bilang na ito ng mga implementable at non-implementable?

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Speaker. Based on official data, ang terminated or suspended

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: po na projects, one of the factors being may problema sa lupa, is 43.

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: 43 projects. With regards to updates as to even those ongoing projects

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: na might be terminated because of disputes in land

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: implementation. Again, the DND cannot give information on it given that

segments.speaker: Rep. Bella Vanessa B. Suansing
segments.text: the implementing agency would be the DPWH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Speaker, mahirap po na ganyan po ang kasagutan sa atin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Dahil malinaw po sa DND-DPWH Joint Memorandum Circular No. 44,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Series of 2024, na may tatlo pong mahalaga na obligation dito ang DND.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Unang-una, lahat ng potential military infrastructure projects ay magmumula

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa DND AFP units. Pangalawa, DND Secretary ang mag-e-endorse ng validated,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: evaluated, at prioritized list ng TICAS projects sa DPWH Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At pangatlo, at pinakamahalaga, Mr. Speaker, may obligasyon ang DND representative

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Supervising Team na mag-observe ng conduct ng procurement activities, mag-monitor ng project progress, mag-resolve ng issues habang ini-implement ang projects at magsumite ng monthly accomplishment reports.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ito po yung dahilan kung bakit hinihingi natin sa DND mismo yung lagay, yung status ng mga proyektong ito, dahil hindi naman po biro yung ₱38 billion. Mas mataas pa po yan sa buong budget ng DOST para sa susunod na taon. Kaya napakahalaga ng bawat piso na ginagastos sa mga proyektong ito.
